title: O PEN S CHOLAR : S YNTHESIZING S CIENTIFIC L ITERATURE WITH R ETRIEVAL - AUGMENTED LM S
abstract: O PEN S CHOLAR is a retrieval-augmented language model that synthesizes scientific literature by identifying relevant passages and generating citation-backed responses. It outperforms other models, including GPT-4o and PaperQA2, in correctness and citation accuracy.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine you're a researcher trying to stay up-to-date with the latest scientific discoveries. With millions of papers published every year, it's a daunting task. OpenScholar is here to help. It's a specialized language model that retrieves relevant passages from a massive database of 45 million open-access papers and synthesizes them into concise, citation-backed responses.

By leveraging retrieval-augmented language models, OpenScholar can provide more accurate and reliable information than traditional language models.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
OpenScholar consists of three key components: a datastore of 45 million papers, a retriever that identifies relevant passages, and a generator that synthesizes the retrieved passages into a response. The retriever uses a bi-encoder to encode the query and passages, and a cross-encoder to rerank the passages based on relevance.

The generator then takes the top N passages and generates an initial response, which is refined through iterative self-feedback and retrieval.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
OpenScholar was evaluated on the ScholarBench benchmark, which consists of 2,967 expert-written questions and 208 long-form answers across four scientific disciplines. OpenScholar outperformed other models, including GPT-4o and PaperQA2, in correctness and citation accuracy.

The results show that OpenScholar achieves a correctness score of 51%, compared to 45% for GPT-4o and 40% for PaperQA2.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
OpenScholar has significant implications for the scientific community. By providing accurate and reliable information, OpenScholar can help researchers stay up-to-date with the latest discoveries and accelerate the pace of scientific progress.

Additionally, OpenScholar can assist in identifying gaps in current research and suggesting new areas of study.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
OpenScholar introduces several key innovations, including a self-feedback inference loop that refines the response through iterative retrieval and generation. OpenScholar also uses a cross-encoder reranker to improve the relevance of the retrieved passages.

These innovations enable OpenScholar to outperform other models in correctness and citation accuracy.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
OpenScholar is available as a public demo, allowing you to try it out for yourself. Simply enter a scientific query, and OpenScholar will generate a response with citations.

You can also access the OpenScholar code and models on GitHub, and use them to build your own applications.
